commonGenerationDirection: Production-ready genuine low-resolution pixel art assets for a 2D overhead grid puzzle game. Original designs. Use the visual discipline of classic farming RPG game sprites: economical readable pixel clusters, warm limited palette, consistent scale, exactly one pixel thick dark brown contour on objects, at most two flat shade tones per material. Hard pixel edges. NO painted illustration, no 3D render, no isometric diamond tiles, no gradients, no anti-aliasing, no bloom, no haze, no vignettes, no background glow, no soft shadows, no noise texture.

assets.generationBrief: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row 1: grass, dirt path, wet cultivated mud, turquoise irrigation water. Row 2: wood floor, dense hedge, horizontal wood bridge over water, vertical bridge. Row 3: arrow sign, harvest handcart with pumpkins and green pennant, produce crate, apple tree. Row 4: bush, wicker harvest basket with carrot and turnip, gold discovery spark, green success star. Opaque terrain cells; genuinely transparent isolated objects. Each cell represents 32 logical pixels.
assets.finalEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the existing game terrain sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows. Edit ONLY the top-left square cell (row1,column1). All other 15 square cells must remain unchanged in layout, content, size, colors and alpha. This tile will repeat many times in a small grid, so extreme visual restraint is essential. No outlines around the tile. Preserve the exact canvas dimensions, the exact 4x4 layout, and transparency on isolated objects in rows3-4. Hard low-resolution pixel art. No background halos.

assets.finalEditPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the attached farmer sprite sheet.
